title: Lavington, NSW - Infrastructure Restoration
current_summary: An unplanned access network outage affecting some services in Lavington, NSW has been resolved. Field technicians replaced faulty network hardware. Services were restored at 2:30 AM AEST on 8 July 2026.

updates.content: Resolved: Some customers in Lavington, NSW experienced a service interruption. Our network partner replaced faulty hardware and services were restored at 2:30 AM AEST on 8 July 2026. If your connection is still not working, please restart your modem/router and contact our support team. Thank you for your patience.
